name: Sharman Joshi
bio: Sharman Joshi (born 28 April 1979) is an Indian stage and film actor. Joshi began his career with supporting parts in Godmother (1999) and Lajja (2001). He is most recognized for his performance as Raju Rastogi in 3 Idiots (2009).
